verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover uploading custom models from Hugging Face, local files, S3 or Azure Blob Storage. LoRA adapters can be served two ways: live merge into the base model with no inference overhead, deployed via a single firectl command, or multi-LoRA with adapters loaded dynamically at request time. Dedicated on-demand GPU deployments host these models. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that custom-weight upload and LoRA serving work as documented.
